summary: Reasons for Ansible 12 removals: cisco.ise unmaintained, ibm.spectrum_virtualize renamed to ibm.storage_virtualize, cisco.asa and community.network deprecated, and sensu.sensu_go failing inclusion requirements.
questions: Why was sensu.sensu_go removed from Ansible?

answer_card.title: Why collections were removed in Ansible 12
answer_card.answer_md:
- **cisco.ise:** unmaintained; install with `ansible-galaxy collection install cisco.ise`.
- **ibm.spectrum_virtualize:** renamed to **`ibm.storage_virtualize`**; update your FQCNs.
- **cisco.asa** and **community.network:** previously deprecated, now removed.
- **sensu.sensu_go:** unresolved sanity test failures violate inclusion requirements; install with `ansible-galaxy collection install sensu.sensu_go`.
